prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
**[result]** Done. The print is Hokusai's *The Great Wave off Kanagawa* (ca. 1831, public domain), verified visually from `./print.jpg`.

**[action]**
- `./result.json` — records `boats: 3` and `mountain: "Mount Fuji"`, plus the sampled palette and composition notes.
- `./scene/index.html` — single self-contained file, all geometry built in code (no textures, no build step), importing only `three@0.170.0` from jsdelivr and a Google Font.

**[what I took from the print, and how I know]**
- **Boats: 3.** I inspected `./print.jpg` directly: one tumbling under the great wave's curl at left, one small at mid-right before Fuji, one large at bottom center-right. All three are rebuilt as low-poly ochre hulls with dark rowers in the same positions (confirmed in screenshots).
- **Mountain: Mount Fuji.** The small snow-capped cone at the horizon center-right, framed by the wave's trough — rebuilt as a prussian-blue cone with a paper-white cap on the horizon.
- **Composition/palette:** great wave dominating the left, curling right with pale foam claws and spray; flat cream sky with a gray cloud band; deep prussian blues (`#1b4477`, `#2b5d8c`) against cream (`#efe3c2`); vertical Japanese title 神奈川沖浪裏 at top-left. Verified by opening the file in a browser and screenshotting two revision rounds: first render had the wave off-frame and Fuji oversized; re-framed camera and fixed boat hull backface culling; second pass synced foam-cap motion with their swells.
- **Motion (assumption, brief left open):** gentle wallpaper-style animation — the wave breathes and sways, foam claws bob, boats pitch/heave on the swell, slow camera drift. All amplitude kept low so the composition stays recognizable.

**[next]** Browser tab opened for review has been closed. If the client wants stronger motion (e.g. a full wave-break loop) or a wider/vertical wallpaper crop, that's a one-parameter change in the camera/animation block.
